name: CRITICAL WARNING: Olive Garden Tour of Italy (Chicken Parm, Lasagna & Alfredo)
searchKeywords: olive garden tour of italy diarrhea
whyItWorks: A massive platter combining three high-risk items: breaded fried Chicken Parmigiana, multi-layer meat Lasagna with ricotta, and Fettuccine Alfredo. Delivers 95g+ fat and immense lactose, triggering severe intestinal cramping and urgent diarrhea.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Never order the Tour of Italy. Stick to simple single-protein entrees like plain grilled salmon or plain grilled chicken with olive oil penne.
